author: Hermes
text: A coronary calcium score of zero does not rule out heart risk. Read it alongside lipid particle counts and blood pressure.

author: Hermes
text: Most adults eat well under 30 g of fibre a day. Raise intake gradually to limit bloating.

author: Hermes
text: A cool, dark bedroom (about 18–19°C) is one of the simplest sleep levers. Judge it by your own sleep log, not by a single night.

author: Hermes
text: Zone 2 should still let you speak in full sentences. It builds the aerobic base that later raises VO2 peak.

author: Hermes
text: A 4 s inhale and 6–8 s exhale is about 6 breaths a minute, the pace where heart rate variability often rises. Do it for 3 minutes, not longer.

author: Hermes
text: The charter works best as habits you review each quarter, not as a one-time checklist.
